raw.rationale: Tacalcitol is a vitamin D receptor agonist with antiproliferative and differentiating effects, and VDR is broadly expressed across cancer lineages, but PRISM single-concentration data show little lineage-selective killing; modest selectivity might occur in skin or leukemia/lymphoma-related contexts, though none of the listed lineages are strongly VDR-dependent. Base rates and lack of published PRISM lineage selectivity make most probabilities very low.
